requirements.requirement: Collect, organise and analyse against the full list of requirements
requirements.note: This page maps each requirement to where it is met.

requirements.requirement: Executive summary outlining the important details
requirements.note: One page: the answer, six findings with sources, the decision rule and the plan.

requirements.requirement: Suggestions on improving the site, in a dedicated section, nothing implemented before review
requirements.note: 18 proposals, each marked 'for review - not implemented'.

requirements.requirement: List of questions, information and answers needed before a decision, with ways to find what is missing
requirements.note: 33 questions: what is known, what is missing, how to find out, who can answer.

requirements.requirement: Deep research on the area: geography, income, schools, population, jobs and other economic factors
requirements.status: Done for city, county and metro area; blank at neighbourhood level
requirements.note: Neighbourhood figures need the address, which is withheld.

requirements.requirement: Projection system for the area and the property
requirements.note: Official projections to 2035 and beyond, plus a scenario model with 36 labelled settings, breakevens and stress cases.

requirements.requirement: Risks for every possible decision, business-as-usual and black swan
requirements.note: 37 risks, each rated against each of six strategies.

requirements.requirement: Best decision for the property and for the owner: preservation and growth at manageable risk
requirements.status: Done as a decision rule; the final choice needs the owner's private facts
requirements.note: The rule says what to do under each answer the tenant and the advisers can give.

requirements.requirement: Verified official sources; a source link on every table row
requirements.note: 50 sources read on 2026-11-12; every row links to its source.

requirements.requirement: Blank and flagged when a value cannot be confirmed; nothing inferred
requirements.note: Blank rows are listed with the reason and how to obtain the value.

requirements.requirement: Review the repository line by line; links for manual review; flag irregularities
requirements.status: Done as a structural inventory and a cross-check of key figures
requirements.note: Every file and line is inventoried; key figures in earlier workbooks are compared with today's verified values. Not every historical sentence was re-checked.

requirements.requirement: Privacy first: no personal information, placeholders only
requirements.note: Enforced by the build: the site fails to build if a personal identifier pattern appears.

requirements.requirement: A live site with a clean landing page and category subpages, simple and dashboard-like, findings in tables
requirements.note: One consolidated site at the root; earlier workbooks are in the archive.
A stale integration claim was taken over under the 60-minute rule; other sessions' folders are untouched.

requirements.requirement: Final integration: merge, re-verify combined data line by line, no broken links, publish
requirements.note: The verifier checks every row, every internal link in the published tree, privacy and model reproducibility.

requirements.requirement: Pull request to main with summary, sources and flagged items; merge; confirm deploy; record result
Flagged and unverified items on a clearly labelled Flagged for Review page with source links
requirements.note: Blank rows and irregularities, each with a link.
